Market today: The tech and chip sectors are under heavy pressure, driven by negative Nvidia news regarding China export restrictions and a significant leadership change. This mood is directly impacting your concentrated book.

Your holdings: Most of your book is flagged "SELL." SOXL (-78.08%), MUU (-60.23%), and SMCI (-42.25%) are facing severe drawdowns, amplified by your margin usage. QQQ (-7%) and SMH (-27.06%) are also concerning.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further developments from the Commerce Department regarding chip exports and Nvidia's stock performance, as it will dictate the broader chip sector's direction.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater leveraged positions given the strong negative sector headwinds.
plays: Re-evaluate your "SELL" status leveraged positions like SOXL and MUU; their deep losses are amplified by margin and decay.
Consider a new inverse position like SQQQ (entry 42.4-42.29, stop 42.01) or SOXS (entry 52.18-52.02, stop 49.3) as a hedge against continued tech weakness.
